blocks.text: The first parcel is $24.14. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Kiln dry wrap is not ticked. Wildflower honey jar, 12 oz is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
The later bill is twenty seven dollars and fifty eight cents every 30 days.

product.description: The honey is raw and set in a glass jar with a metal lid.
product.name: Wildflower honey jar, 12 oz

trick.evidence_text: Seasonal refill will bill again every 30 days for twenty seven dollars and fifty eight cents.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
